top_stories.title: Cisco warns of max severity ISE zero-day exploited in attacks
top_stories.summary: Cisco has released security updates to address a maximum-severity zero-day vulnerability in its Identity Services Engine (ISE) that is being actively exploited in attacks. Cisco ISE is a network access control and policy enforcement platform widely used for authentication, authorization, and access management in enterprise environments.

top_stories.title: NIST and CISA finalize playbook to stop token theft and forgery
top_stories.summary: NIST and CISA have finalized guidance titled "Protecting Tokens and Assertions from Forgery, Theft, and Misuse" (NIST IR 858x) to help federal agencies and cloud service providers defend identity and access tokens against forgery, theft, and misuse. The playbook directly addresses token-based authentication and authorization mechanisms central to modern IAM and zero trust architectures.

top_stories.title: The Vendor Rush Is Here: Agent Governance Hits Its Tipping Point
top_stories.summary: Multiple major infrastructure vendors have reached general availability with standalone agent governance products, marking a significant shift in the IAM landscape. Okta's July 2026 product innovations were highlighted as pushing furthest into new territory among the competing vendors.

top_stories.title: Windows 11 KB5124008 update breaks domain trust for some users
top_stories.summary: Microsoft's Windows 11 KB5124008 security update is breaking domain trust relationships on some enterprise systems. Affected users are unable to log in with valid domain credentials, prompting Microsoft to investigate the issue.

top_stories.title: N0va Phishkit Targets US and EU Businesses: A New Challenge for Identity Security
top_stories.summary: A phishing kit called N0va is targeting organizations in the US and EU by impersonating trusted services and abusing legitimate authentication flows to compromise user identities. The attacks bypass traditional malware detection by leveraging valid account access, posing a direct threat to identity security and authentication systems.

news.title: Microsoft shares workaround for Windows domain login issues
news.summary: Microsoft identified a known issue preventing Windows 11 users from logging in with valid domain credentials after installing September 2026 security updates. A temporary workaround has been shared while a permanent fix is in development.

news.title: AWS’s new sign-up gives accounts spend caps, email invites, and agent-set permissions
news.summary: AWS has introduced a new sign-up flow allowing users to authenticate via Google, GitHub, or Apple login, with coding agents automatically configuring permissions within project environments. The new system includes agent-set permissions and a project-based access model, with optional central governance features available for accounts requiring multi-region management.

news.title: GNOME 51 adds passkey logins, offline maps and drawn PDF signatures
news.summary: GNOME 51, released on September 16, introduces passkey login support at the Linux desktop login screen alongside other features like offline maps and PDF signatures. The passkey functionality adds FIDO2/passkey authentication options to the GNOME display manager for Linux distributions including Fedora 45 and Ubuntu 26.10.

news.title: Active Exploitation Attempts Target WSO2 API Manager JWT Bypass With Forged Admin Tokens
news.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-5430, CVSS 9.8) in WSO2 API Manager is being actively exploited in the wild, allowing attackers to forge admin tokens by bypassing JWT authentication through improper cryptographic signature verification. The flaw can result in full account takeover, as reported by watchTowr.

news.title: KREMLIN Banking Malware Hijacks Chrome and Edge to Steal Credentials and Session Tokens
news.summary: Elastic Security Labs has identified a Brazilian banking malware called KREMLIN, tracked as REF9334, that hijacks Chrome and Edge browsers to steal credentials and session tokens. The malware uses browser extensions to target users of Brazilian banks by impersonating their login pages, directly compromising authentication credentials and session data.

news.title: KuppingerCole Analysts Include Regula in the Leadership Compass for Its Identity Data Control and Document Verification
news.summary: KuppingerCole Analysts has included Regula in its 2026 Leadership Compass for Identity Verification, recognizing the vendor among leading providers in the space. Regula's inclusion is attributed to its privacy-first approach to identity checks and document verification capabilities.

news.title: AWS STS simplifies session token size limits and adds session token size monitoring
news.summary: AWS Security Token Service (STS) has replaced its previous packed policy size and overall session token size limits with a single unified token size limit. This change gives IAM users more flexibility when working with session policies and session tags, and adds monitoring capabilities for session token size.

news.title: Architecting resilient authentication with Amazon Cognito multi-Region replication
news.summary: Amazon Web Services published guidance on architecting resilient consumer identity and access management (CIAM) systems using Amazon Cognito with multi-Region replication. The article covers how to maintain authentication availability as businesses scale across geographies, addressing failover and redundancy for user sign-in and access services.

news.title: How Cisco is confronting the security crisis of agentic AI
news.summary: Cisco's VP of product for identity has warned that shadow AI agents are present in nearly every environment, posing a significant security challenge. The company has developed Duo Agentic Identity, a product designed to address identity and access management challenges specific to agentic AI systems.

news.title: Operationalizing least privilege: Automate IAM remediation through your CI/CD pipeline
news.summary: The article addresses operationalizing least privilege access controls in AWS by automating IAM remediation through CI/CD pipelines. It focuses on the practical challenge of permission sprawl that occurs during application deployment and proposes automated tooling as a solution for maintaining least privilege at scale.

news.title: What Actually Lifted Okta Stock To A One-Year High?
news.summary: Okta's stock rose 12% in a single session, closing at $186.45, its highest price in one year. The article examines the specific factors driving the significant share price increase for the IAM vendor.

news.title: 3BB Attacker Used MeshCentral Backdoor for Root Access, Targeted Subscriber Credentials
news.summary: An attacker compromised 3BB, a major Thai broadband provider, using MeshCentral as a backdoor to maintain root access to internal machines. The attack targeted subscriber credentials, with threat intelligence firm Hunt.io discovering the intrusion through an exposed attacker-controlled server.

news.title: Malicious Twitch Browser Extension Leaks OAuth Tokens From Nearly 31,000 Users
news.summary: A malicious browser extension named "Twitch Enhanced Viewer | JeetBot" exfiltrated OAuth tokens from nearly 31,000 Twitch users to proxy servers linked to a Russian commercial bot service. The extension was distributed across both the Google Chrome Web Store and Mozilla Firefox Add-Ons store, exploiting OAuth token theft as the attack vector.

news.title: IDrive Adds Microsoft Entra ID Backup to Strengthen Identity and Access Protection for Microsoft 365 Organizations
news.summary: IDrive has added Microsoft Entra ID Backup functionality to its IDrive Microsoft 365 Backup solution. The new capability is designed to help organizations protect and recover identity and access data stored in Microsoft Entra ID.

news.title: Attackers Use Passkey Phishing to Hijack Microsoft Cloud Accounts and Exfiltrate Data
news.summary: Microsoft disclosed two threat actor campaigns involving abuse of third-party email delivery infrastructure for financial fraud and passkey-themed social engineering to breach cloud environments. The campaigns include over one million scam emails sent between August 3-5, 2026, with attackers impersonating CEOs to hijack Microsoft cloud accounts and exfiltrate data.

news.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act to Enforce New Reporting Requirements
news.summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act begins enforcing a 24-hour mandatory reporting requirement for serious product security incidents affecting European organizations. This regulatory change imposes new compliance obligations on organizations handling software and connected products, including IAM systems and vendors operating in the EU market.

news.title: Identity-Based AI Attack Threatens Security of Enterprise Data
news.summary: A new attack technique called "workflow identity hijacking" has been identified that can bypass standard security controls by exploiting unauthenticated entry points to compromise enterprise data. The attack targets identity-based weaknesses in AI workflows, enabling unauthorized access without triggering conventional authentication defenses.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch batch addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. AI is being credited with accelerating vulnerability discovery, though security teams are struggling to prioritize testing and deploying the volume of fixes.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian driver's licenses, allegedly sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the breach, which affects a widely-used identity verification provider.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved unauthorized access to accounts, relevant to IAM as a case study in credential-based cloud account compromise.
